rows.Col10: Update Notes:

Survived a gunshot wound to the head on Aug. 31, 2025, and is not expected to play in 2026. He is walking and training again, led the team onto the field for the Aug. 29 opener and aims to return to football within a year.
The true freshman was ruled out for all of 2026 in early March with an undisclosed injury that also cost him spring practice. He can redshirt and keep his freshman eligibility for 2027.
Tore his ACL in fall camp on Aug. 11, and Mike Norvell confirmed the next day that the injury ends his season. The cornerback transfer (Notre Dame) was expected to add depth to a thin secondary.

The true freshman had a procedure on the same left knee in which he tore an ACL before his senior year of high school, and Mike Norvell ruled him out for the season in mid-September. He played six special teams snaps against SMU before the setback.
Went down after eight special teams snaps in the Sept. 7 loss to SMU, and Mike Norvell ruled the true freshman out for the rest of 2026 the following week. The injury has not been disclosed.
Tore his ACL in the Oct. 31 loss to Clemson and will miss the rest of the season, per ESPN's Pete Thamel. He was the team's leading receiver with four touchdown catches at the time.

Left the Sept. 19 loss at Alabama on crutches with a lower-body injury after a 65-yard catch-and-run and has not played since. The staff hoped for a late-season return, but he is out again for the Nov. 13 game at Pitt with no announced timetable.

Out for the Nov. 13 game at Pitt after a midweek downgrade from questionable, extending an absence that dates to at least early October. The injury is undisclosed, and the cornerback has spent most of the season on the availability report.
The freshman linebacker has been out with an undisclosed injury since a late downgrade ahead of the Oct. 3 Virginia game. He remains out for the Nov. 13 game at Pitt with no timetable given.

Injured his left ankle late in the first half of the 43-35 double-overtime loss at Miami on Oct. 17 and left on a cart with the leg in an air cast. He had surgery in Miami and will miss the rest of the season, though the school expects a full recovery.

Left the Oct. 17 loss at Miami after 14 snaps with an undisclosed injury and has not played since. The starting cornerback will miss a third straight game on Nov. 13 at Pitt, with Charles Lester III filling in.

Official report 2026-11-13: game time decision. Game 2026-11-13. Previous context: The kickoff specialist landed on the report with an undisclosed injury the day before the Oct. 31 Clemson game and missed both that game and the trip to Boston College. He is probable to return on Nov. 13 at Pitt.

Hurt in the Oct. 31 loss to Clemson and sat out the win at Boston College. Interim coach Rick Stockstill said he is getting closer, but he was downgraded from questionable to out for the Nov. 13 game at Pitt.

Started against Clemson on Oct. 31 but missed the win at Boston College with an undisclosed injury. Interim coach Rick Stockstill said he is getting closer, though he is out again for the Nov. 13 game at Pitt.

The running back left the Oct. 31 Clemson game with an undisclosed injury and played limited snaps at Boston College a week later. He is out for the Nov. 13 game at Pitt, leaving true freshman Amari Thomas as the lead back.

The starting center was carted off with his right leg in an air cast late in the first half of the 31-24 win at Boston College on Nov. 7. He is out for the Nov. 13 game at Pitt with no timetable announced, and sophomore Chavez Thompson is set to start in his place.
